title: Johnny Depp's Ebenezer takes $1.5 million in preview screenings
summary: Audiences are rating the film far more highly than critics as its opening weekend begins.
body:
Ebenezer: A Christmas Carol, starring Johnny Depp, took $1.5 million from preview screenings in North America on Thursday, according to studio figures reported by Deadline and Variety.

The film opened fully today. Paramount is projecting about $20 million in North America over the weekend and a similar amount from 63 other countries, for a worldwide opening of around $40 million.

Critics and audiences disagree

Reviews have been poor, with a score of 33% on Rotten Tomatoes. Cinema-goers have been much warmer: audiences polled by PostTrak gave it four and a half stars out of five.

Forecasters still expect it to be the number one film of the weekend, ahead of Godzilla Minus Zero.

Weekend figures are projections, not results. Sources: Deadline, Variety.
